public/manifest.json.description: Manifest uses 'any maskable' combined purpose for icons which is not PWA best practice. Should have separate icons: regular icons with 'any' purpose and maskable icons (with safe zone padding) with 'maskable' purpose.

public/icon-template.svg.description: SVG template for the unslump! logo using 4-color layered design (indigo #4f46e5, teal #14b8a6, orange #f97316, pink #ec4899). Can be used as base for generating maskable icon variants with proper safe zone padding.
